thread:
lina-pm: Quick heads-up — UberEdge SI is blocked on marketplace image replication + govcloud validation. Customer go-live Wed, need an arch review + escalation ASAP.
jared-se: On it. What exactly is failing? any error screenshot?
lina-pm: Partner says marketplace validation returns 403 when pulling signed image. Looks like the marketplace account role can't access replicated ECR layers; partner mentions ephemeral CI tokens.
ravi-eng: If it's cross-account ECR access, likely need a replication role update + KMS policy tweak. Paging @meilin-sre and @aisha-sec for egress/KMS checks.
meilin-sre: Got it. Can you paste the exact error and any request IDs?
lina-pm: From partner logs: "AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::999999999:assumed-role/marketplace-role is not authorized to: ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer". Partner uploaded CI log: https://s3.redwood.internal/uberedge/ci/logs/replicate-2026-03-22.log
aisha-sec: KMS key policy may be blocking cross-account decrypts. Also remember GovCloud uses a different AWS partition — confirm partner isn't using commercial endpoints.
jared-se: I can try a quick repro in staging. Who can give me a role ARN to assume?
lina-pm: Partner provided role ARN: arn:aws:iam::888888888:role/uberedge-marketplace-replica
ravi-eng: I'll prepare a minimal policy change to allow ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer for that role and open a PR to infra. If we need immediate unblock we can patch partner-side.
jared-se: quick policy snippet I used locally: ```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer","ecr:BatchGetImage"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled ephemeral job 'replicate-test-uberedge' to staging at 14:30 UTC. Link: https://deploy.redwood.dev/jobs/replicate-test-uberedge
meilin-sre: Also checking partner VPC egress — they might be whitelisting only commercial AWS ranges. @lina-pm can you confirm their NAT config?
lina-pm: Partner confirms NAT but only whitelisted commercial region endpoints, not GovCloud. Asking them to open govcloud IP ranges + KMS perms now.
aisha-sec: Flagging for security review. If we change key policy we need org-owner signoff. I'll join the call at 13:45 UTC to approve emergency exceptions.
thomas-ops: If we can't unblock quickly, fallback is to publish a partner-hosted AMI in GovCloud for them to use (manual). Not ideal but buys time for marketplace flow.
lina-pm: :thumbsup: Thanks. Standup call 13:45 UTC — calendar invite sent. I'll DM partner and attach our go-live checklist, will update this thread after staging run.
jared-se: If staging replication passes we can promote to prod with a canary. Keep me posted.
lina-pm: Update: staging run succeeded after adding ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer to replica role. Partner reports marketplace validation passed. Monitoring now.
aisha-sec: Security note: open ticket to tighten KMS key policy after go-live and add alerting for cross-account decrypt events. Filing now.
lina-pm: Filed ticket PROD-4321 (postmortem + KMS policy tweak). Partner to confirm final smoke tomorrow; will close thread once confirmed.
